item.title: About
item.description:
I used to live in Moscow. Not anymore.

Why did this happen, and did we have a choice? Can we change anything, and if so, how?

The slogan “How we ended up with such a life”, like many ideas in this blog, comes from Igor Alexandrovich Yakovenko. I recommend his YouTube channel if you understand Russian.

What I wish for my country: Link to heading

  • Stop the war with Ukraine.
  • Return the territories taken from Ukraine.
  • Free political prisoners and prisoners of war.
  • Compensate Ukraine for the damage.
  • Hold Putin accountable.
  • Abolish the FSB.
  • Remove imperial foundations from the legislation.
  • Free the media.
  • Dismantle the repressive apparatus.

My blog notes. Help me find answers and solutions.
